name: afrihub-monorepo
description: AfriHub - Pan-African Tech Community Showcase Website

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "shared,client,server" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace=@afrihub/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@afrihub/client" "npm run dev --workspace=@afrihub/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@afrihub/shared && npm run build --workspace=@afrihub/client && npm run build --workspace=@afrihub/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@afrihub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@afrihub/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@afrihub/server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.preview: npm run build && USE_TEST_DB=true concurrently -n "server,client" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run start --workspace=@afrihub/server" "npm run preview --workspace=@afrihub/client -- --port 4173 --host"
